quality.title: Audio quality
quality.description: Choose how much data your server sends. Higher quality sounds better and uses more bandwidth and storage.

hints.original: The file exactly as stored on your server, lossless if the file is lossless. Best sound, most data.
hints.high: Your server converts to Opus at up to 320 kbit/s. Very close to the original for most music.
hints.normal: Your server converts to Opus at up to 192 kbit/s. A good balance for mobile data.
hints.low: Your server converts to Opus at up to 96 kbit/s. Saves the most data.

playback.title: Playback
playback.crossfadeHint: Blends the end of a track into the start of the next one.
playback.skipSameAlbum: Do not crossfade within an album
playback.skipSameAlbumHint: Consecutive tracks of an album then run seamlessly into each other without crossfade, as on live and concept albums.
playback.needsNormalization: Available once volume leveling is on.
playback.gaplessHint: When a track follows another one directly, it starts without an audible pause. Live albums and mixes play as they were recorded.

normalizationHints.off: Every track plays at its own level. This is the purest option.
normalizationHints.track: Evens out the loudness from track to track.
normalizationHints.album: Keeps the loudness differences within an album and evens out between albums.
normalizationHints.auto: Uses album gain while an album plays and track gain everywhere else.

playback.targetHint: How loud the leveled music should be overall.
playback.preventClippingHint: Lowers the gain of a track when raising it would cause distortion.
playback.analyzeUntaggedHint: Tracks that carry no loudness information are measured while they play.
playback.monoHint: Plays the same signal on both channels.
playback.balanceHint: Shifts the sound between the left and right speaker.
playback.widthHint: 100 % is unchanged. Lower values move the sound toward the center, higher values widen it.
playback.equalizerHint: Shape the sound with graphic or parametric filters, presets and Deep Bass.
playback.resumeHint: If you open the app again within this time, or kept listening on another device, playback continues exactly where it stopped.
playback.syncQueue: Save the queue on the server
playback.syncQueueHint: Saves the queue and position on your server so other devices and apps can continue there (Navidrome and other Subsonic servers).

output.title: Output
output.description: Where the sound goes and how it gets there.
output.deviceHint: The device Musify plays through. The system default follows what you pick in your system settings.
output.exclusiveHint: Takes over the device so the system mixer cannot change the signal. Bit-perfect output needs exclusive mode, the equalizer and all other sound effects off, and the volume at 100 %. Other apps are silent while it is on.

display.title: Appearance
display.description: Colors, size and language of the app.
display.accentHint: Used for buttons, sliders, favorites and highlights. Album headers, the full-screen player and lyrics take their colors from the cover.
display.zoomHint: Makes everything in the app smaller or larger.
display.onlineLyricsHint: When your server has no lyrics, the app looks them up on LRCLIB (lrclib.net). Title, artist, album and length are sent there for that.

system.title: System
system.description: Start with Windows, window and notifications.
system.autostartHint: Starts minimized in the tray, so media keys work right away.
system.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
system.closeToTrayHint: Closing only hides the window and the music keeps playing. Quit from the tray icon.
system.notifyHint: Shows the new track when the app is not in front.
system.desktopOnly: These settings are only available in the desktop app.
system.discordHint: Shows what you are listening to on your Discord profile: title, artists, cover and progress.
system.discordCoversHint: Discord needs a public image, so artist and album are sent to the music search of Deezer and Apple. Without it Discord shows the Musify logo.
system.needsDiscord: Available once “Show in Discord” is on.

home.title: Home
home.description: Which rows the home page shows and in which order.
home.rowsHint: Use the arrows to move a row; the switch shows or hides it.
home.autoPlaylistsHint: Playlists Musify builds from your listening history.
home.needsAutoPlaylists: Available once automatic playlists are on.

autoHints.heavyRotation: What you played most in the last 30 days. Appears after two weeks of listening history.
autoHints.rediscovered: Old favorites you have not played for a while. Appears after two months of listening history.
autoHints.allTime: Your most played songs ever, including the play counts of your server.
autoHints.topYear: Appears together with the Recap from 1 December.
